notes.finding: Full owned C445/H59 independently read canonically and separately rendered with no gaps, parser errors or substitutions. All129 baseline facts and30 proposal operations reviewed. Stored diffuse, specular and alpha have no local reader; ambient and shininess do. Alpha conversion has no explicit clamp.

Channel bit8 selects two channels and updates each nonnull active light shininess. Low mode2 selects vertex descriptors,4 applies qualifying ambient light and masks, default fixed descriptors. PE descriptor takes precedence over render flags. Finalization inserts a passthrough TEV stage only when current count is zero.

GX setters call the API before sequential cache stores. Primitive invalidation keeps offsets and resets sizes to zero, so zero-size matching-offset requests can hit. Render invalidation converts byte Boolean sentinels to255; enum -1 inputs are not locally rejected. Three additional inherited unconditional invalidation guarantees are deferred in top-level dispositions.
